zoe_sales: starting POC with HarborSystems. objective: stream inference logs + traces to their Datadog tenant. initial run: traces show up but logs lack trace id, plus occasional 429s from our /v1/export. any quick checklist?
mike_se: common checklist: 1) confirm trace header propagation (traceparent/x-redwood-trace-id) from edge -> worker; 2) ensure exporter maps to Datadog's dd.trace_id; 3) respect upstream Retry-After on 429s and implement batching/backoff.
ash_ops: what runtime? node/go/python? async contexts differ. also share the 429 response headers so we know which side is rate-limiting.
zoe_sales: node workers. sample headers: `X-Traceparent: 00-7b9c6a4d1f2b3c4d-9f1e2d3c4b5a6f7e-01`, `X-Request-Id: req-44f`. 429 response: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 200
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
Retry-After: 10`
mike_se: Retry-After present -> we should implement exponential backoff + honor Retry-After. For traceless logs: node's AsyncLocalStorage often doesn't propagate into worker pools. pass trace id explicitly to the job payload and attach to logger.
ash_ops: quick node middleware to stash trace id and include in job metadata: `req.redwoodTrace = headerTrace || req.headers['x-request-id']` then `worker.enqueue({trace: req.redwoodTrace, reqId: req.headers['x-request-id']})`. Also ensure exporter sets `dd.trace_id` in spans/logs.
sales-eng: from a commercial perspective: if we throttle or add retries, does that increase their POC billing unexpectedly? customer is cost sensitive.
mike_se: header propagation changes no cost. Increasing concurrency to avoid 429s could increase request counts. Recommended: batching (e.g., 40 items), backoff, and temporary quota bump for demo window if needed.
deploy-bot: ALERT: export-cluster limit reached for org harbor-poc-11 at 16:05 UTC. spike -> X-RateLimit-Remaining=0
zoe_sales: can we do a short quota bump (24h) for the demo without signed contract? customer prefers trial.
sales-eng: we can authorize a 24h trial override, ops just needs to apply and set auto-rollback; finance notified.
nash_ops: apply 24h override and route traffic to a less-loaded worker pool if we need immediate relief. I can flip override now, will schedule rollback.
deploy-bot: ACTION: quota_override applied for org harbor-poc-11 by nash_ops; expires in 24h.
mike_se: exporter mapping notes: set `span.dd.trace_id = inboundTraceId || generated128bitId` and include `log.dd.trace_id` for logs. If some services emit 64-bit ids, pad/normalize to 128-bit hex so Datadog correlator matches. Also add a Datadog pipeline rule to join logs<>traces on `dd.trace_id` or `request_id`.
zoe_sales: implementing middleware + exporter changes: 1) persist trace into job payload, 2) map to dd.trace_id, 3) batch size=50 + backoff honoring Retry-After. will push to staging and test. can someone validate quota override while I run tests?
sales-eng: approved. we have audit trail and auto-rollback.
zoe_sales: pushed changes to staging. running test now. will report back with sample log lines showing `dd.trace_id` and any remaining 429s. back in ~30m. :eyes:
